plugins.name: limit-resume
plugins.description: Auto-resumes a turn killed by a rate limit or API error once the limit resets; shows 5h/7d usage and warns at 85%.

plugins.name: ship-state
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: branch, dirty files, ahead/behind, PR, CI and prod deploy for the repo the session works in; toasts when CI finishes or prod goes live.

plugins.name: timeline
plugins.description: Vertical orchestration timeline: talk on the left, work milestones with progress and live subagent cards on the right, per repo across sessions.
